Set to the proxy deployer at initialization so positions can be loaded\r\n  ///         while the coordinator sits with the multisig; reassign or revoke via `setLoader`.\r\n  address public loader;\r\n\r\n  // ====== INPUT STRUCTS ====== //\r\n\r\n  /// @notice Input shape for a schedule configured at proxy initialization.\r\n  struct ScheduleInput {\r\n    /// @notice Number of full vesting months before the first positive unlock.\r\n    uint8 cliffMonths;\r\n    /// @notice Human-readable schedule label for UI display.\r\n    string label;\r\n    /// @notice Per-month unlock weights in parts-per-million, aligned with `monthTimestamps`.\r\n    uint32[] monthlyUnlockPpm;\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  // ====== ERRORS ====== //\r\n\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when a caller other than `coordinator.owner()` invokes an admin function.\r\n  error NotCoordinatorOwner();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when a caller other than the loader or `coordinator.owner()` invokes a loader function.\r\n  error NotLoaderOrCoordinatorOwner();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when a caller other than `coordinator.stakingContract()` invokes `claimFor`.\r\n  error NotStakingContract();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when month timestamps are empty or not strictly increasing.\r\n  error InvalidTimestamps();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when a schedule cliff or existing schedule is incompatible with the timestamp calendar.\r\n  error InvalidSchedule();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when an explicit unlock curve is malformed.\r\n  error InvalidUnlockCurve();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when more than 8 schedules are added.\r\n  error ScheduleLimitReached();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when loading into a schedule that is currently inactive.\r\n  error ScheduleNotActive();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when a schedule index does not exist.\r\n  error InvalidScheduleType();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when an address argument is zero.\r\n  error ZeroAddress();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when an amount argument is zero.\r\n  error ZeroAmount();\r\n  /// @notice Thrown when the packed calldata passed to `loadPositions` is malformed.\r\n  error InvalidData();\r\n\r\n  // ====== EVENTS ====== //\r\n\r\n  /// @notice Emitted  Human-readable schedule label.\r\n  event VestingScheduleAdded(\r\n    uint8 indexed scheduleType,\r\n    uint8 cliffMonths,\r\n    string label\r\n  );\r\n  /// @notice Emitted when a vesting devdoc.details: Deployed as a transparent proxy. Admin identity is read from      `SmartWalletCoordinator.owner()` at call time; there is no local owner storage.      `loadPositions` additionally accepts a `loader` account, set to the proxy deployer      at initialization and rotatable via `setLoader`, so position loads do not depend      on where the coordinator ownership sits.      Supports up to 8 schedule types (one bit per type in the per-user uint8 bitmask).

loadPositions(bytes).details: Encoding: for each beneficiary — address (20 bytes), count (1 byte),      then count × [scheduleType (1 byte) + amount (12 bytes, uint96, big-endian)].      Multiple entries for the same (beneficiary, scheduleType) are additive.      Using packed bytes instead of ABI-encoded structs cuts calldata by ~76%.

returns._0: Number of timestamps in the shared vesting calendar.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

setLoader(address).details: Callable by the current loader or the coordinator owner, so loading rights can      be rotated without moving coordinator ownership. Zero address revokes them.

setMonthTimestamps(uint64[]).details: Replaces any previously uploaded array. Timestamps must be strictly increasing.      Call this before adding schedules or loading positions.

params.timestamps: Array of month-end unix timestamps (expected length: 40).

params.scheduleType: Index of the schedule to update.

returns._0: The ERC-20 token address read from `coordinator.stakingToken()`.

withdrawToken(address,address,uint256).details: Intentionally permits withdrawing tokens backing vesting positions. This is a      break-glass action and can leave vesting claims underfunded.

params.amount: Token amount to withdraw in wei.
params.recipient: Address that receives the withdrawn tokens.

userdoc.notice: Holds preloaded vesting allocations and releases tokens to beneficiaries according to         month-based schedules. Schedules share a single uploaded array of 40 month-end         timestamps and can use either linear or explicit monthly unlock curves. Multiple         off-chain lots for the same (user, schedule) are consolidated into one on-chain position.         All claims are routed through the Staking contract.
